== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
* Added from the old Players Committee website: the May 2006 volunteer call (https://web.archive.org/web/20060617220108/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=8), the 26 May 2006 design Q&A (https://web.archive.org/web/20060617220030/http://www.swccgpc.com/modules.php?name=News&new_topic), the Virtualization Market Guide request and 2008 policy post (https://web.archive.org/web/20080906211140/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=94), the Virtual Set 15 quote (https://web.archive.org/web/20080712072006/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/modules.php?name=News&file=article&sid=81) and "10 Questions with Scott Lingrell" (https://web.archive.org/web/20081009225918/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php?id=7).
* '''Possibly faulty data:''' in the 8 October 2008 interview Lingrell says "Sorry, I won't be at worlds", but this page's Tournament Results list him at the [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2 and Team Tournament, 10–12 October 2008). The sentence was left out of the article until this is resolved.
* '''Missing data:''' the interview names "Eric" (who left design), "Evan", "Dennis" and "JW" (PDF makers) without surnames, so they are not linked.

=== Missing data ===
* Not added: his September 2004 plan to look into a local event in Lawrenceville, New Jersey in early October 2004; no later post confirms it took place.
* Not added: his 23 November 2004 teaser of something to be released in late December 2004; it does not say what.
* Not added: his February 2005 statement "Sanctuary = that was definitely me" in answer to a rumour list naming Asteroid Sanctuary. No Asteroid Sanctuary virtual card page exists and the post does not say which printing is meant, so the card cannot be identified yet.
* The DecipherCon 2002 Classic playtest he ran is already on the page (Service row of 2002).
